international.title: UK exposed to polycrisis of threats amid government ‘complacency’
international.summary: Lords report calls for urgent new approach to resilience planning in face of cyber-attacks, sabotage and climate crisis Ministers are complacent in the face of fast-changing and increasingly interconnected threats to the UK, and must act quickly to increase national resilience to possibly very major crises, a parliamentary report has found. While Labour recently launched a “Be Ready” campaign, advising households to have stocks of food and water, most of the public are unaware of the scale of potential threats from cyber-attacks, proxy acts of violence or strikes on underseas cables, as well as natural disasters such as extreme weather and flooding, it said.
